model_plan.question: What percentage of children were fully immunised in each district by year?

view.title: District Immunisation Coverage by Year
view.note: Select a year to compare districts. The percentage shows the share of children fully immunised out of those due; the count bars show the underlying numbers. The file cannot explain why coverage differs between districts.

interpretation_guard.caveat: The file contains only counts and does not include reasons for differences in coverage.
